title: Mapping the Multilingual Margins: Intersectional Biases of Sentiment Analysis Systems in English, Spanish, and Arabic

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating predicted emotion intensity scores on the Equity Evaluation Corpora (EECs) by substituting male and female given names and gendered noun phrases into sentence templates, and analyzing the results using Beta regression.

Evaluating predicted emotion intensity scores on the Equity Evaluation Corpora (EECs) by substituting names statistically associated with Black and White individuals into sentence templates, and analyzing the results using Beta regression.

Evaluating predicted emotion intensity scores on multilingual Equity Evaluation Corpora (EECs) by substituting names statistically associated with Latino, Arab, and Anglo individuals into Spanish, Arabic, and English sentence templates, and analyzing the results using Beta regression.

Measuring the interaction between gender and racial/ethnic cleavages (e.g., Black women, Latino men) by using an interaction term in a Beta regression model applied to the emotion intensity predictions from the Equity Evaluation Corpora.
